newsitem.title: JAPAN: DDI SHARES ASK-ONLY ON SLOWING PHS DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: DDI SHARES ASK-ONLY ON SLOWING PHS DEMAND.

text.p: Shares of domestic long-distance telecommunications company DDI Corp were ask-only on Friday morning, depressed by recent data showing slowing growth in the number of new subscribers for the personal handyphone system (PHS), traders said.
A unit of DDI is involved in the PHS business.
At 0210 GMT, DDI's share price was ask-only at 717,000 yen, against Thursday's close of 777,000 yen.
DDI Corp's PHS unit, DDI Tokyo Pocket Telephone Inc, said on Friday that the number of new subscribers totalled 60,400 in July, down from 128,700 in June.
It said the decline in new subscribers was partly due to a shortage of some popular models of PHS phones.
